name: progress-board
description: Session and overall-plan progress: a two-line band above the prompt and a /progress panel

stepReminder.title: Step reminder calls
stepReminder.description: Initial reminder threshold: 3, 5 or 8 counted calls.

autoDone.title: Automatically complete merged work
autoDone.description: Initial global default; plan overrides take precedence.

retention.title: Ended-session display hours
retention.description: Show ended sessions for 6, 24 or 72 hours; disk history remains seven days.

contextWarning.title: Context warning percentage
contextWarning.description: Warn at 70, 80 or 90 percent context usage.

notifications.title: Waiting notifications
notifications.description: Notify the most recently used session about new waiting items after ten seconds of quiet; sound requires host playback support.

monitor.title: Suggestion-only progress monitor
monitor.description: Suggest changes only when evidence changed. Disabling retains unresolved suggestions.

monitorMinutes.title: Monitor interval in minutes
monitorMinutes.description: Initial monitor cadence; at least five minutes. The Settings tab can override it.

barGlyph.title: Progress bar glyph
barGlyph.description: One cell of the progress bars. Use █ or ▅ if ■ draws two cells wide in your terminal.

enforceGoal.title: Require a goal for multi-step work
enforceGoal.description: Once per session, pause the fourth tool call if the model has not recorded a goal.
